title: Weapon aimbot guide: staff, bow and gun
desc: Per-weapon aimbot profiles for Pro tier—staff chains, bow tracking and gun finishers for Ranked.

body.text: [Pro tier](/products/fortnite-cheats/) aimbot shines on timing-heavy loadouts. Staff skill rotations, bow tracking in instances, and gun finishers are Ranked staples—tune smoothness and bone priority per class instead of one global snap.
Save separate portal profiles for staff, bow, gun and sword. Hotkey swap in-match without reopening the loader. Test each profile in Creative before Ranked.

Enable Aimbot with moderate FOV and high smoothness for mid-range skill chains. Bone Priority on torso for chain transfer, chest for first-skill peeks. Save as class_pvp; lower delays only in instances preset. Practice the skill pattern in Creative before enabling aimbot.
Closer FOV, sticky aim on, smoothness slightly lower than staff. Hotkey macros can fire heals or mobility when three enemies are within radius—add 80–120 ms delay so item use feels natural.
Tight FOV, bone priority torso/chest, short sticky window. Pair with [radar](/blog/fortnite-radar-hack-guide/) so you do not push into a stacked squad.
Start with portal Ranked presets—not max sliders. Full Ranked guide: [aimbot for Ranked](/blog/fortnite-aimbot-ranked-guide/). ESP wallhack third-part alerts prevent blind peeks into five-man stacks.
Class profiles ship in the portal with [Pro](/products/fortnite-cheats/) at fnhacks.org. Secure checkout, loader guide, then Ranked.
